observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the same all-black monocrystalline solar panel leaning against a wall, outdoors.
Watermark reads 'INNOSON GLOBAL GROUP' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on both images.
No visible rating label, specification sticker, wattage, cell count, or brand name on the panel frame or back sheet in either photo.
Background shows other panels and frames stacked, suggesting a dealer yard rather than a single item for sale.
No inverter, battery, or charge controller is shown despite being mentioned in the seller's text.

claims.claim: High Quality Solar Panels, Inverters, Lithium & Tubular Batteries, Charge...
claims.evidence: No inverter, battery, or charge controller visible in either photo; only one panel shown.

risks.risk: Wattage and cell count unknown, which drives most of the price difference between comparables.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the rating label on the back of the panel showing watts, voltage, and cell count.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest wattage tier seen in comparable 'all-black' panels

risks.risk: Brand unknown (e.g., Canadian Solar, Longi, Suntex) which affects resale value and warranty trust.
risks.proof: Photo of brand/model sticker or frame engraving.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unbranded/generic, not premium brand

risks.risk: Condition unknown — could be new, used, or refurbished; no output test shown.
risks.proof: A multimeter or solar tester reading clip showing open-circuit voltage under sunlight.

risks.risk: Physical damage (micro-cracks, frame bending) not visible due to glare and low-angle shots.
risks.proof: Straight-on, well-lit photo of the full panel face and frame edges.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rating label (wattage, voltage, cell count, brand) on the back of the panel.
A test clip or photo showing voltage output under sunlight.
Photo of the panel's full face in bright, even light without glare.
Confirmation of whether the panel is new or used.
response.reason: The panel's wattage, brand, and condition are not readable in either photo, and these are the main price drivers among comparable all-black solar panels; a worst-case price cannot be fixed without at least the rating label or a wattage figure.
